fusions.name: Snagged Flesh
fusions.desc: Rakes one of your afflictions out of the target with crooked fingers, dealing 8 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, which it uses up.

fusions.name: Gaff Through Gaps
fusions.desc: Works a barbed finger between the target's plates, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled In
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line and hauls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you, holding their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught on Something
fusions.desc: Once every 60 seconds, a blow that would have killed you snags short instead and leaves you at 1 health.
